title: P42 — Bug fixes: step counter sync, meal scan speed, theme consistency, home UI polish
context: Multiple UX bugs reported by owner after manual testing. Fix all items below. Branch: ux-v2.

tasks.title: Step counter sync — Walking tab vs Home screen
tasks.description: Steps shown in the Walking/Activity tab do not match steps shown on the Home screen. They should share a single source of truth. Fix: use one shared Riverpod provider (e.g. StepsProvider) that both screens read from. No duplicate pedometer streams.

tasks.title: Step counter accuracy — slow and inaccurate
tasks.description: Step counting is slow to update and inaccurate. Fix: ensure pedometer events are processed immediately (no unnecessary debounce >500ms). Validate against platform pedometer; if using 'pedometer' package, confirm it is reading step_count not step_detection.

tasks.title: Meal photo scan — speed and accuracy
tasks.description: Meal scanning via camera is slow (>5s) and results are doubted. Fix: (a) show a loading indicator immediately on capture, (b) compress image before upload (max 800px, quality 75), (c) use a faster prompt that asks for JSON only — no markdown, (d) add a confidence note in the UI if the scan result seems low-quality.

tasks.title: Theme system — full audit, dark/light/orange accent, zero conflicts
tasks.description:
Full theme audit and rebuild for maximum consistency. Requirements:
- TWO base themes: Dark (background #0D0F12, surface #1A1D21) and Light (background #F8F9FA, surface #FFFFFF)
- ONE accent color: Orange #FF6B35 used consistently for CTAs, active icons, progress rings, highlights
- All text colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on their background
- No hardcoded Colors.white / Colors.black / Colors.grey anywhere in lib/ — use theme tokens only
- AppBarTheme, BottomNavigationBarTheme, CardTheme, InputDecorationTheme, ElevatedButtonTheme all fully defined in the theme
- Dark mode: no pure white text, use #E8E8E8 for body, #FFFFFF for headings only
- Light mode: no pure black, use #1A1A1A for body
- Run flutter analyze after — zero theme-related warnings

tasks.title: Home screen — Today's Calories widget redesign
tasks.description:
The 'سعراتك النهاردة' (Today's Calories) section is poorly designed: text is small and inconsistent. Redesign:
- Large centered calorie number (32sp, bold, orange)
- Subtitle: 'من أصل X سعرة' in 14sp muted color
- Three macro pills below: Protein / Carbs / Fat — each with colored dot + value
- Remaining calories in a colored badge (green if >200, orange if 50-200, red if <50)
- Consistent padding and card elevation matching the design system

tasks.title: Meal tabs — food item rows should be compact and consistent
tasks.description:
Food item rows (e.g. 'صدر فراخ', 'أرز مطبوخ') must be compact cards:
- Icon or food emoji on the left (40dp)
- Food name bold 14sp + portion size 12sp muted below
- Calories on the right bold 14sp + macros 11sp muted
- Consistent height ~64dp, divider between items
- No oversized text, no layout overflow

tasks.title: Walking screen — add Steps chart and Calories chart
tasks.description:
The Walking screen is missing charts. Add:
- A bar chart showing steps per day for the last 7 days (use fl_chart BarChart)
- A line chart showing calories burned from walking per day for the last 7 days
- Both charts should use the orange accent color for bars/lines
- Show a 'No data yet' empty state if fewer than 2 days of data exist
- Charts must respect dark/light theme

tasks.title: CRITICAL — water_logs: invalid UUID id field (400 error every minute)
tasks.description: water_logs table receives id='water_2026-10-18' which is not a valid UUID. Supabase rejects with error 22P02. This error repeats every ~60 seconds and is breaking water tracking entirely. Fix: search lib/ for any string like 'water_' used as an id. Either (a) remove the id from the insert payload and let Supabase auto-generate it (recommended), or (b) use uuid.v4() from the uuid package. Add uuid package to pubspec.yaml if not present.

tasks.title: Auth 422 — 'احفظ تقدمك' Save Progress screen shows error
tasks.description: PUT /auth/v1/user returns 422, causing 'حصل خطأ. حاول تاني.' on the Save Progress screen. Fix: check the updateUser() call — Supabase Auth only accepts fields: email, password, data (user_metadata). Move any extra fields into the data map. Also improve the error message to show a specific Arabic message instead of the generic error.

after_all_tasks: Run flutter analyze — must be 0 errors
Run flutter build apk --debug — must succeed
